collateral_behavior_task.prompt_template: In a separate factual item, use the two registered statements for the assigned fact_id. Exactly one statement is correct; do not identify it in the prompt. Return exactly one integer: 1 or 2 for the correct statement.

contrast_conditions.definition: At a shared decision point, the scenario makes the focal objective receive attentional priority while the competing demand is present; both objectives remain available and feasible.
contrast_conditions.label: Shield the focal objective

contrast_conditions.definition: At the same kind of decision point, the scenario makes the competing demand receive attentional priority while the focal objective remains present; both objectives remain available and feasible.
contrast_conditions.label: Attend to the competing objective

description: Whether a focal objective is represented as receiving priority amid competition, tested downstream by a fresh allocation of limited attention without stating the target state.

behavior.warning: The downstream item avoids direct target-state wording and is not a persistence or plan-rigidity measure.

independence_requirements: Use new domains, actors, tasks, and distractors not present in probe prompts.
Cross distractor salience, focal urgency, and switching cost independently.
Do not ask the model to label goal shielding, persistence, or plan flexibility.
independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: In a new situation, a focal task and an unrelated distractor compete for limited attention. The item states which numbered option is the focal task and which is the distractor. Allocate exactly 100 attention points in numbered-option order. Return exactly two integers on separate lines; the two integers must sum to 100.

metadata.downstream_independence: The downstream item is a standalone attention-budget episode with new tasks and no copied goal-management language.
metadata.option_order_policy: Every choice/allocation downstream cell registers a balanced target_option or primary_position schedule; parser scoring uses that frozen field.
metadata.primary_question: Does an attentional-priority direction transfer to maintaining focus on an independent task under distraction?
metadata.release_note: Supersedes the v1 direct priority-cue wording for future review and generation; v1 artifacts remain historical.

probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short goal-management scenario. Track which objective is salient at the shared decision point without answering a later task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Keep the scenario in working memory without adding a response.
title: Focal-task priority with clean attention budgeting
